== frame quick_copy cursor=2,20
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ cp source copy
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $
@0 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@0 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 cp
@2 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
== frame quiet_copy cursor=4,20
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ cp source copy
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ cp --no-progress source quiet-copy
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $
@0 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@0 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 cp
@2 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@2 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 cp
@4 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
== effect copy
|tiny bytes
== effect quiet_copy
|tiny bytes
